office: the passport services in Portugal (the IRN at Lisbon airport); abroad, Portugal's consular posts

routes.label: normal: available at the service on the 5th working day after the order reaches INCM
express, collected at the service in Portugal: the 2nd working day after (EUR 20 more)
urgent, applied for by noon, collected at the service in Portugal: the next working day (EUR 30 more)
urgent at Lisbon airport: the same day, from 16:30 (EUR 35 more)
applied for at a consular post or section

note: Fees and service levels of Portaria n.º 361/2023 (read in the copy the Madeira regional government publishes); a later amendment hasn't been looked for. Some islands of the autonomous regions add one to three working days. The frequent traveller's passport (EUR 100) isn't modelled. Validity isn't in the portaria (a lead: the passport decree-law).

sources.title: Diário da República, 1.ª série, N.º 221, 15 de novembro de 2023, Portaria n.º 361/2023 (copy published by the Governo Regional da Madeira, madeira.gov.pt)
